name: movie-3-end
description: #76: movie, its end. From movie-playing, Circle every second until Stframe_no reaches the opening's last frame number (1790, measured on Tier 2): movie_end is the first frame it does. Then 5 s more, and it must still read 1790 (stopped_ok: the counter holds, no movie plays) with g_GameState field (mode_ok). match: a rerun from the same snapshot.
